# Proof artifacts

This directory contains evidence produced by the test commands, never invented product claims.

* `pure-tests.log` is generated by the deterministic local harness.
* `bench-test-*.log` is generated only after a real Frappe/ERPNext bench test completes through [`scripts/test-daytona.sh`](../scripts/test-daytona.sh) or [`scripts/test-marketplace.sh`](../scripts/test-marketplace.sh).
* [`screenshots/`](screenshots/) contains the capture manifest and naming rules. It is intentionally empty until a real, reviewable app UI is available.

The Marketplace listing keeps `screenshots` empty while there is no real UI capture. A deterministic test log proves code paths only; it does not prove a Marketplace screenshot or deployment.
